create_SharedBuffers: create a SharedBuffers instance to allocate shared memory tensors for trajectory data across RL workers
get_trajectory_buffers: get free trajectory buffer indices from the shared buffers queue for storing new rollout experience
free_trajectory_buffers: free trajectory buffer indices back to the shared buffers queue after the learner finishes processing
init_tensor: init a shared memory tensor with the given dtype and shape for storing RL trajectory data
ensure_memory_shared: ensure all tensors in a dict are placed in shared memory to prevent programming errors
